message.content:
This is the regression commit. The commit "Let layered sources take ownership of lower source" changed the ownership semantics. The bug is that `zip_source_window` doesn't take ownership of the lower source (it calls `zip_source_keep(src)`), but the code in `zip_source_zip_new.c` was changed to NOT free `src` after creating the window source. This creates a use-after-free because the window source's lower source gets freed when the window source is freed, but the caller also frees it.

Wait, let me re-read. The commit changed `zip_source_zip_new.c` to remove `zip_source_free(src)` calls after creating layered sources. But for `_zip_source_window_new`, the window source does NOT take ownership (it calls `zip_source_keep(src)`). So the caller still needs to free `src` after creating the window source. But the commit removed that `zip_source_free(src)` call.
